title: Microsoft Store won't open, or downloads and installs fail
summary: The Store closes right away, shows a blank page, or stalls on downloads. Resetting the Store fixes most cases.
cause: The Store's cache or app files are damaged, or the PC's date and time are wrong.
steps: Press Win+R, type wsreset.exe and press Enter. A blank window opens, then the Store launches by itself.
Check that your date and time are correct: Settings > Time & language > Date & time > turn on 'Set time automatically'.

Repair then reset the app: Settings > Apps > Installed apps > the three dots next to Microsoft Store > Advanced options > Repair. If that doesn't help, click Reset. Reset is stronger and clears the Store's saved settings and sign-in.
Install pending updates: Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates.
ifStillBroken: Open Terminal (Admin): right-click Start and choose Terminal (Admin). Type DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth and press Enter. When it finishes, type sfc /scannow and press Enter. Restart when both are done.

links.text: Microsoft: Microsoft Store won't launch, reset the cache
